generatedProse.practice-connection:
You now have a way of approaching practice and work-based learning that will serve you in every experience from here on. Each placement, project or field experience is a chance to aim, act and evidence, and the same experience gives more when you do. The habit to keep is simple: decide what you want from an experience, take the initiative while you are in it, and record what you learned so you can show it.

That same habit carries into professional life. Wherever you are given real work and expected to grow from it, the people who get the most, and can show for it, are the ones who treat each experience this way. The cycle you have just learned to run is one you will use long after you graduate.
